fusions.name: Gathering Speed
fusions.desc: A diving blow that deals 7 damage, up to 1.6 times that at the full 7 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it, up to 40%. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Trampling Pass
fusions.desc: Sweeps over every enemy within 3 tiles for 12 damage and drives them back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Flat Out
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Paved Stride
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
